nodes.title: Fin centroid aft of CG
nodes.how: B3: AVL Cn_beta >= P:requirements.cnbeta_min with fins, tubes and props at R1 geometry (CL-B3-CNB re-run). Flight: FBWA yaw doublet on the twin; no growing yaw oscillation hands-off.
nodes.note: Geometry screen only, not Cn_beta. With the tubes through the wing at x 0.045 (D-04) the fin centroid is 0.14 m (43 % chord) aft of the CG and no fin area is ahead of it; at R0 it was 0.04 m with 40 % ahead. This is the geometric reason B3's option O4b turned Cn_beta from -0.105 to +0.044 /rad. The FW yaw actuator question (CR-J1-05, F4) stands: Plane has no FW yaw stabilisation by default.

nodes.note: Zero at R1: the fin LE (tube axis 0.045) is 1 mm aft of the CG target 0.044; at the aft CG limit 0.049 about 1.5 % of the fin area is ahead of the CG, still negligible.

nodes.title: Prop planes ahead of the CG
nodes.how: B3: include propeller normal force (Ribner) in the AVL/hand pitch and yaw stability sums.
nodes.note: 0.05 m (15 % chord) ahead of the CG at R1 (was 0.21 m, 70 % chord, at R0): the destabilising prop normal-force moment is 4x smaller than it was. B3's R1 neutral point should move aft (D-17).

nodes.title: SUPERSEDED (bare-tube screen): tube mode separation from forcing
nodes.how: C4 re-derives with the half-fin as a bonded shear web (CR-J1-03 / CR-B4-07); H1 tap test; hover VIBE < P:requirements.fc_vibe_max_ms2 and Clip = 0 (SRC-J1-AP-VIBE).
nodes.note: FAILS on the bare tube: f1 ~183 Hz sits 2 % from the hover 2P (180 Hz) and 9 % from the cruise 2P (200 Hz). The forcing sweeps 90-156 Hz (1P) and 180-312 Hz (2P) between hover and the capped maximum, so no bare-tube mode in 72-374 Hz clears 20 % at every steady point: the fin bond must put the first mode above ~375 Hz, or the tap test must show it damped (R-VIBRATION allows either). C4 owns the fix. D-100 (2026-11-13): no limit and no requirement link: the bare tube is not the design; C4's 3-D station model of the bonded fin (CL-C4-SIM-SEP) and T-C4-TAP-D3 are the claim and test of record for R-VIBRATION.

nodes.title: Cruise lift coefficient at the gate
nodes.how: B1/B2 from the drag polar; airspeed log in cruise.

nodes.title: Static margin trimmable, elevons neutral (S5010)
nodes.how: B2: XFOIL cm at the cruise Re (~3.5e5) with elevon deflection; B3: AVL trim at the cruise CL and SM 5 %. Flight: elevon trim position in FBWA (A2 limit elevon_trim_travel_max).
nodes.note: Informational since D-19 (SM stays 0.05; CR-J1-02 rejected). The S5010's cm0 is about zero (-0.004 at Re 2.3e5, +0.003 at 3e5, B2), so elevons-neutral it trims no positive static margin (-0.9 %): all 5 % of SM is carried by elevon up-trim (B2: about -4 deg at CL 0.5), and that penalty is already inside the trimmed CLmax 0.80 (CL-B2-CLMAX-DESIGN). The MH 45's +0.0145 would have trimmed 3.3 % at this CL. R-STATIC-MARGIN is verified by B3's CL-B3-CG-AFT, not by this screen.

nodes.title: SUPERSEDED (D-32, AS150U fitted): XT60 continuous rating
nodes.how: Maker sheet (35 A at 12 AWG, 85 K rise); Holybro says 30 A for < 60 degC rise. Bench: 34 A for 10 min, connector < 60 degC.
nodes.note: PROPOSED from the datasheet; +4 % on the Amass figure against 33.75 A, and Holybro's 30 A (< 60 degC) already fails it. Against E2's 37.4 A (CL-J1-DISCONNECT-REQ-PESS) the XT60 fails on both figures. 12 AWG leads required.

nodes.title: SUPERSEDED (D-32, AS150U fitted): XT60 continuous rating vs E2 gate-wind hover
nodes.how: Same heat run at 37 A for 10 min; rise <= 60 degC.
nodes.note: Was FAILS by 6 %. D-100: no limit and no requirement link, the XT60 is not fitted (D-32 AS150U; CL-J1-AS150U-CONT and F1's CL-F1-DISC-* verify R-DISCONNECT).

nodes.title: SUPERSEDED (D-32, AS150U fitted): XT60 one-minute rating
nodes.how: Compare with the logged full-throttle pack current on the thrust stand (4 stations) or F4's output cap.
nodes.note: FAILS the 120 A momentary case (4 x 30 A). F1: AS150U, or a claim that the <= 5 s case at the 100 A limiter is inside a cited XT60 short-time rating (A1's condition, CHANGE-LOG CR-A2-08 row). D-100: no limit and no requirement link, the XT60 is not fitted (D-32 AS150U).

nodes.title: AS150U continuous rating
nodes.how: Open the Amass AS150U sheet before ordering (UNVERIFIED reseller value); bench 37 A for 10 min.

nodes.title: AS150U instantaneous rating
nodes.how: Same sheet; the pre-charge contact is the weak point (forum melt report): inspect after every full-throttle run.

nodes.title: Tap test, fin + tube + motor assembly
nodes.procedure: Clamp the finished half-fin at the through-core block; tap the motor; FFT of a phone accelerometer or the FC IMU raw log; first mode must be >= 20 % from 1P and 2P at hover, cruise and the capped maximum (outside 72-374 Hz), or its damping ratio recorded for C4.

nodes.title: Three-point bend of the bought tube
nodes.procedure: Span 0.8 m, load at centre in 0.5 kg steps to 4 kg, dial gauge; E = F L^3 / (48 I delta). Replaces ASM-J1-E-TUBE.

nodes.title: Connector heat run
nodes.procedure: 37 A through the mated pair for 10 min on the bench supply or thrust stand; IR thermometer; rise <= 60 degC.
